name: Lina Announcer Expanded
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

A custom version of the original Lina announcer from Dota 2, expanded with additional voice lines from Lina's hero responses to cover a wider range of events.

Voice lines were adjusted and remapped to better fit League's announcer system.

---

### Lina announcements

*(original League announcements → Lina voice lines)*

**General**

• Welcome to Summoner's Rift → Prepare for battle.   
• 30 seconds to minions spawn → Thirty seconds to battle.       
• Minions have spawned → The battle begins.   

• Summoner disconnected → Burned out?         
• Summoner reconnected → Flame on!  

• Victory → A blaze of glory!   
• Defeat → We're cooked!

**Objectives**

• Your team destroyed a turret → Put to the torch.   
• Your team destroyed an inhibitor → Ashes to ashes. 

• Your turret destroyed → Up in smoke.   
• Your inhibitor destroyed → You're on the hot seat!  

• Your inhibitor respawn → Warms my heart.  
• Your inhibitor respawning soon → Getting warmer.   

• Enemy inhibitor respawn → Aww, fizzled out.  
• Enemy inhibitor respawning soon → What in the blazes?  

**Combat**

• Ally slain → Uh! / Snuffed out.    
• Enemy slain → Burn 'em all! / Scorch 'em! / Light 'em up!  

• You have slain an enemy → Oh, you're hot! / Let it burn! / Burn, baby, burn.  
• You have been slain → Hot or not? / So cold.   

• Shutdown → Ooo! Toasty! / That wasn't too bright.    
• Executed → Denied.           
• Ace → Helter swelter! / That was hot!  

**Multikills**

• First Blood → First Blood!          
• Double Kill → Double Kill!  
• Triple Kill → Triple kill!           
• Quadra Kill → Ultra kill!  
• Penta Kill → Rampage! 

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Killing spree! / Hot stuff!  
• Rampage → Mega kill! / Monster kill!

(Dota 2 Rampage was intentionally NOT used here because in Dota 2 it represents a Pentakill-equivalent killstreak rather than a regular streak tier.)

• Dominating → Dominating!  
• Unstoppable → Unstoppable!   
• Godlike → Godlike! / Sick burn!      
• Legendary → Holy shit! / Ownage! / Wicked sick!
